_source: Transcribed by hand from the text printed by notebook cell 8d (the run the project owner pasted). This is NOT the original diagnosis.json: it lacks the per-image lists (false_positives_images, missed_images) and the names of the 2 excluded labels. To keep the full analysis, copy Drive persisted/diagnosis/blob_over_extrusion/diagnosis.json to inference/training/diagnosis/blob_over_extrusion/diagnosis.json.

reviewer_observations._source: Visual review of the false-positive montage by the project owner; not machine-verified and not an audit of each of the 21 'unannotated' boxes.
reviewer_observations.unannotated_boxes_sit_on: visible bumps on the part surface (e.g. a grey gear), not clean background; in one case (a green cup) next to a real under_extrusion label
reviewer_observations.interpretation: likely real blobs that the source dataset did not label
